scope_guards: Strategic noise maps are modelled annual-average evidence and not site measurements.
Road, rail, aviation and industrial noise sources remain distinct.
Lden, Lnight and LAeq indicators must not be silently merged.
Noise Important Areas prioritise management and are not automatic planning refusal zones.
Noise action plans are programmes and not completed mitigation.
Environmental-permit noise plans and planning noise assessments are distinct routes.
Map absence is not proof of quiet conditions or acoustic suitability.
No score or promotion is written without exact source, measurement/model, receptors, proposal, mitigation and planning evidence.
